title: Lultrills sparks flames with blazing debut single "Oh Okay"
htmlContent: San Francisco's own Lultrills isn't asking for permission with his very first single, "Oh Okay". At 21, the Bay Area rapper is delivering a blast of fire and fearlessly self-made track to the game. "Oh Okay" is high-energy, statement pop completed with a mischievous streak and cutting confidence. Whether flexing on the beat or dismissing the haters, Lultrills does it all with a smirk, a wink, and a clear message that says he's here, and he doesn't need to wait on anyone's approval. It's the sincerity that separates "Oh Okay." Lultrills is the architect of his own sound. Between mixing, mastering, and even designing the cover art himself, this young artist is building a movement. With each second of the track pulsing with that raw energy, it feels like an introduction to an entire aesthetic. The beat is tough, the delivery is slick, and those hooks burrow through your brain long after the bar fight ends. Lultrills threads his flow through the chaos pretty effortlessly, delivering lines as catchy as they are cutthroat. He knows who he is, and he does not give even the slightest damn if you can follow along. That's part of the charm. https://open.spotify.com/track/4j7awRYaXlhHeoiV8dJQit For those who understand the experience of staying winning while people kick up a debate, "Oh Okay" is for you. It's for the misfits, the makers, the people too busy creating to get caught up in criticism. And if this is what Lultrills sounds like for the first end of his first series of drops, the guy's back catalog must sound just as crazy and catchy. And with "Oh Okay," Lultrills bursts through the door and kicks it off the hinges. This one keeps your eyes on him.
